trello.name: Renew wildcard SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com which expires September 1st and deploy it to the load balancers no later than August 22nd to provide buffer. Also rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh in the same change window; it expires two weeks after the public cert. Migrate both certificates to cert-manager for automated renewal going forward to avoid manual annual renewal. Acceptance criteria: wildcard SSL and internal CA certs are renewed and deployed by August 22nd, cert-manager Issuer/ClusterIssuer and Certificate resources are configured and validated for both certs, auto-renewal test succeeds, and no manual renewal is required annually.

trello.name: Implement PDF export for reports with demo GIF
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deliver PDF export for reports with both backend and frontend work as one task, target end of month. Backend: render report to PDF using headless Chrome. Frontend: add export button and progress state for long-running reports. As part of completion, record a short demo GIF for marketing changelog. Acceptance criteria: export button visible in reports UI, PDF generation works for standard and large reports with progress indicator, backend service uses headless Chrome and returns valid PDF, demo GIF recorded and provided for changelog, feature passes QA by end of month.

trello.name: Restore staging parity with production and prevent drift
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Staging is three migrations behind production and is blocking QA. Immediately run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring schema in line with production. Then build a nightly job that diffs staging schema against production and posts an alert to the infra channel if divergence is detected. Acceptance criteria: staging database schema matches production after migrations run today, nightly diff job is deployed and scheduled, job posts to infra channel on divergence, and no further manual drift occurs.
